'Gabina' translates to a front-row taxi experience, symbolizing the show's journey from point 'A' to 'B.' It claims to have won several international awards and features well-known hosts from the region. article_content: Chinese state media report that 20 workers have been killed in an accident at a tin mine in central China's Hunan Province. According to Xinhua news agency, an explosion caused by a gas leak occurred on Thursday at the mine in Lengshuijiang City, leading to the collapse of two elevators. The agency states that 15 workers died immediately, while five others succumbed to their injuries despite receiving emergency treatment. Additionally, five workers were injured and are in stable condition at a local hospital. A worker, who wished to remain anonymous, claimed that safety protocols had been ignored in recent months. Xinhua reports that an investigation is underway to determine the cause of the accident and whether negligence played a role. Chinese mines remain some of the most dangerous in the world. Over 3,000 fatalities were recorded in coal mine accidents last year alone. Some information for this report was provided by AFP and Reuters.
translated_content: Media negara China melaporkan bahawa 20 pekerja terbunuh dalam kemalangan di lombong timah di wilayah Hunan, China tengah. Agensi tersebut menyatakan bahawa 15 pekerja meninggal dunia serta-merta, manakala lima yang lain meninggal dunia walaupun menerima rawatan kecemasan. Selain itu, lima pekerja lain cedera dan kini berada dalam keadaan stabil di hospital tempatan. Seorang pekerja yang enggan dikenali dakwa bahawa protokol keselamatan telah diabaikan beberapa bulan kebelakangan ini. Xinhua melaporkan bahawa siasatan sedang dijalankan untuk menentukan punca kemalangan dan sama ada kecuaian manusia terlibat. Lombong di China kekal antara yang paling berbahaya di dunia. Lebih 3,000 kematian direkodkan dalam kemalangan lombong arang batu tahun lalu sahaja. Maklumat untuk laporan ini disediakan oleh AFP dan Reuters.

article_content: This is the final day of campaigning in Israel ahead of a pivotal election. Security concerns dominate the race, with polls showing Benjamin Netanyahu and his Likud party maintaining a narrow lead. The situation in the Gaza Strip remains volatile, with Israeli airstrikes targeting Hamas positions in response to recent rocket attacks. Islamic Jihad reported casualties during an attempted attack on an Israeli patrol. The two main candidates, Netanyahu and Tzipi Livni, represent starkly different visions for Israel's future. Netanyahu, a former prime minister, emphasizes economic stability and a hardline approach to Hamas, while Livni advocates for a two-state solution. Despite the narrowing gap in polls, voter apathy and unfavorable weather conditions may lead to low turnout. Meanwhile, the far-right Yisreil Beiteinu party, led by Avigdor Leiberman, is gaining momentum. Leiberman's controversial proposals, including border adjustments and loyalty requirements for Arab citizens, have polarized the electorate. His party's strong performance could significantly influence the next government's composition. Early results are anticipated late Tuesday, but the political landscape remains uncertain.

Islamic Jihad melaporkan mangsa semasa cubaan serangan terhadap patroli Israel. Dua calon utama, Netanyahu dan Tzipi Livni, mewakili visi yang berbeza untuk masa depan Israel. article_content: US Navy 16 November 2023From Carrier Strike Group 12 Public Affairs MEDITERRANEAN SEA -- Spanish Navy frigate ESPS Méndez Núñez (F104) joined the Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group (GRFCSG) to participate in urgent operations and conduct advanced training events in the Mediterranean Sea, Nov. 8. This combined effort significantly strengthens Allies' military dominance and rapid response capabilities in the region. Operating under the command of Standing NATO Maritime Group 2, Méndez Núñez conducted a high-stakes replenishment-at-sea with the Lewis and Clark-class dry cargo ship USNS Medgar Evers (T-AKE-13), a critical air defense exercise with the Ticonderoga-class guided-missile cruiser USS Normandy (CG 60), a key leader engagement aboard the world's largest aircraft carrier USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78), and multiple crew familiarization 'cross-deck' visits, which simulated real combat scenarios. "Training with our Spanish ally enhances our interoperability and capabilities to ensure rapid and seamless integration now and in the future," said Rear Adm. Erik Eslich, commander of Carrier Strike Group Twelve and the Gerald R. Ford Carrier Strike Group. "The dynamic security environment demands that we remain ready and postured to collectively deter threats and defend the alliance with overwhelming force." The GRFCSG and Spanish Navy routinely operate together in joint exercises. In 2022, ESPS Álvaro de Bazán (F101) sailed with the strike group during its trans-Atlantic employment and Exercise Silent Wolverine. In June 2023, Gerald R. Ford hosted Spanish distinguished visitors with Naval Striking and Support Forces NATO staff to observe flight operations and daily life while deployed. "It is always a great opportunity for a Spanish Navy ship to train with a carrier strike group to demonstrate our high level of interoperability and common procedures, reinforcing our commitment with NATO, creating deterrence effects and therefore, contributing to have a more secure environment," said Commander David Diaz-Caneja, commanding officer of Méndez Núñez. The GRFCSG provides an inherently flexible naval force capable of deploying across combatant commands to meet emerging missions, deter potential adversaries, reassure allies and partners, enhance security, and guarantee the free flow of global commerce. In total, the GRFCSG is deployed with more than 5,000 Sailors ready to respond globally to combatant commander tasking. Headquartered in Naples, Italy, U.S. Naval Forces Europe-Africa/U.S. Sixth Fleet operates U.S. naval forces in the U.S. European Command (USEUCOM) and U.S. Africa Command (AFRICOM) areas of responsibility. U.S. Sixth Fleet, headquartered in Naples, Italy, conducts the full spectrum of joint and naval operations, often in concert with allies and interagency partners, in order to advance U.S. national interests and security and stability throughout Europe and Africa.
translated_content: Tentera Laut AS 16 November 2023Dari Kumpulan Serangan Kapal Pengangkut 12, Jabatan Perhubungan Awam LAUT TENGAH -- Kapal frigat Tentera Laut Sepanyol ESPS Méndez Núñez (F104) bersama Kumpulan Serangan Kapal Pengangkut Gerald R. Ford (GRFCSG) untuk menyertai operasi kecemasan dan latihan lanjutan di Laut Mediterranean, 8 Nov. Usaha bersama ini mengukuhkan lagi kekuatan tentera Alliance dan kemampuan tindak balas yang cepat di rantau ini. Beroperasi di bawah arahan Kumpulan Maritim NATO 2, Méndez Núñez menjalani operasi pembekalan di laut yang berisiko tinggi dengan kapal kargo kering kelas Lewis dan Clark USNS Medgar Evers (T-AKE-13), latihan pertahanan udara kritikal dengan kapal pemusnah peluru berpandu kelas Ticonderoga USS Normandy (CG 60), pertemuan utama dengan pemimpin di atas kapal pengangkut pesawat terbesar di dunia USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN 78), dan lawatan biasa krew antara kapal yang simulasi senario pertempuran sebenar. "Latihan dengan sekutu Sepanyol kita memperbaiki kebolehoperasian dan kemampuan kita untuk memastikan integrasi yang cepat dan tanpa gangguan kini dan di masa depan," kata Laksamana Muda Erik Eslich, komander Kumpulan Serangan Kapal 12 dan Kumpulan Serangan Kapal Pengangkut Gerald R. Ford. "Kerahsiaan persekitaran keselamatan yang dinamik memerlukan kita untuk kekal bersedia dan berada di posisi untuk menangkis ancaman bersama dan mempertahankan pakatan dengan kekuatan yang mengagumkan." GRFCSG dan Tentera Laut Sepanyol secara rutin beroperasi bersama. Pada tahun 2022, ESPS Álvaro de Bazán (F101) berlayar dengan kumpulan serangan semasa penglibatan trans-Atlantik dan Senaman Silent Wolverine. Pada Jun 2023, Gerald R. Ford menjadi tuan rumah untuk tetamu kehormat Sepanyol bersama staf Pasukan Tentera Laut dan Sokongan NATO untuk mengawasi operasi penerbangan dan kehidupan harian semasa pelayaran. "Ini adalah peluang hebat bagi kapal Tentera Laut Sepanyol untuk berlatih dengan kumpulan serangan kapal pengangkut untuk menunjukkan tingkat kebolehoperasian yang tinggi dan prosedur biasa, mengukuhkan komitmen kita dengan NATO, mewujudkan kesan pencegahan dan dengan itu, menyumbang kepada persekitaran yang lebih selamat," kata Komander David Diaz-Caneja, pegawai memerintah Méndez Núñez. GRFCSG menyediakan satu pasukan tentera laut yang secara semula jadi fleksibel yang mampu ditempatkan di seluruh komandan tempur untuk bertemu misi yang timbul, menangkis musuh berpotensi, memastikan sekutu dan rakan, memperbaiki keselamatan, dan memastikan aliran global perdagangan. Secara keseluruhan, GRFCSG ditempatkan dengan lebih daripada 5,000 anggota tentera laut yang bersedia untuk bertindak global terhadap tugas komandan tempur. Berpusat di Naples, Itali, Pasukan Tentera Laut AS - Eropah/Afrika/Kumpulan Keenam melancarkan operasi tentera laut AS di kawasan tanggungjawab Komando Eropah AS (USEUCOM) dan Komando Afrika AS (AFRICOM). Kumpulan Keenam Tentera Laut AS, yang berpusat di Naples, Itali, menjalankan spektrum penuh operasi bersama dan tentera laut, sering bersama sekutu dan rakan agensi antara lemak, untuk meningkatkan kepentingan nasional AS dan keselamatan serta kestabilan di seluruh Eropah dan Afrika.

article_content: MEXICO CITY - A devastating plane crash occurred on Tuesday when an Aeromexico-operated Embraer jet burst into flames during takeoff in Durango, Mexico. Miraculously, despite the severity of the crash, there were no fatalities, though dozens were critically injured. With 97 passengers and four crew members aboard, the mid-sized jet was nearly full when it met with disaster at around 4 p.m. local time (2100 GMT), according to a statement from airport operator Grupo Aeroportuario del Centro Norte. Passenger Jackeline Flores recounted the harrowing experience, describing the weather as 'apocalyptic.' She and her daughter narrowly escaped through a gaping hole in the fuselage as flames engulfed the aircraft, filling it with thick, choking smoke. Flores, a Mexican national residing in Bogota, Colombia, shared her ordeal. 'A young girl who escaped the plane was in distress, crying because her legs were severely burned.' Her own passport and documents were completely destroyed in the fire. Flores expressed deep gratitude, stating, 'I feel blessed and grateful to God.' Dramatic footage from social media captured the aftermath of the crash, with smoke billowing above the wreckage-littered field. The plane's remnants were unrecognizable, with debris scattered in all directions. According to Alejandro Cardoza, spokesperson for Durango's civil protection agency, the plane made an emergency landing approximately six miles from the airport. However, other officials maintain the crash site was much closer, sparking confusion about the sequence of events. Cardoza reported that around 85 passengers sustained mostly minor injuries, although 37 people were hospitalized, and two remain in critical condition. 'Many passengers walked away from the wreckage, but others were trapped,' he said. The airport operator pointed to severe weather as the primary cause, while another passenger suggested the plane may have encountered a strong air current shortly after takeoff. Aeromexico expressed deep regret, stating, 'The families of all those affected are in our thoughts and hearts.' The investigation into the crash continues, with officials estimating it may take months to determine its cause. Mexican President Enrique Pena Nieto has mobilized government resources to assist, though some have criticized the response as slow. The crash has raised questions about aviation safety and transparency. The Embraer 190, a generally reliable model with one previous fatal accident, was leased by Aeromexico in 2014. The company has pledged full cooperation with the ongoing investigation. Concerns about transparency arose when Aeromexico declined to release the passenger list, and the U.S. Embassy was uncertain about potential American victims. This has fueled anxiety among those awaiting news of loved ones.
translated_content: MEXICO CITY - Satu kecelakaan pesawat yang menghancurkan berlaku pada hari Selasa ketika pesawat Embraer yang dioperasikan oleh Aeromexico meledak dalam bola api semasa lepas landas di Durango, Mexico. Secara ajaib, meskipun keparahan nahas, tidak ada kematian, walaupun puluhan cedera parah. Dengan 97 penumpang dan empat kru di dalam, pesawat sederhana itu hampir penuh ketika bertemu dengan malapetaka sekitar pukul 4 petang waktu tempatan (2100 GMT), menurut kenyataan dari pengendali lapangan terbang Grupo Aeroportuario del Centro Norte. Penumpang Jackeline Flores menceritakan pengalaman yang menghantui, menggambarkan cuaca sebagai 'apocalyptic.' Dia dan anak perempuannya hampir-hampir tidak lolos melalui lubang di fuselage ketika api melahap pesawat, mengisi dengan asap tebal yang mematikan. Flores, yang merupakan warganegara Mexico dan tinggal di Bogota, Colombia, berkongsi kisahnya. 'Seorang gadis kecil yang keluar dari pesawat menangis kerana kakinya terbakar teruk.' Dokumen pasport dan dokumen peribadinya musnah dalam kebakaran. Flores mengucapkan syukur yang mendalam, berkata, 'Saya merasa beruntung dan bersyukur kepada Tuhan.' Gambar dramatik dari media sosial menangkap keadaan selepas nahas, dengan asap mengepul di atas tapak yang dipenuhi serpihan. Sisa pesawat tidak dapat dikenali, dengan serpihan berselerak ke seluruh tempat. Menurut Alejandro Cardoza, jurucakap agensi perlindungan awam Durango, pesawat melakukan pendaratan kecemasan kira-kira enam batu dari lapangan terbang. Namun, pegawai lain menegaskan tapak nahas jauh lebih dekat, menyebabkan kekeliruan tentang urutan peristiwa. Cardoza melaporkan bahawa kira-kira 85 penumpang mengalami kecederaan kebanyakannya ringan, walaupun 37 orang dimasukkan ke hospital, dan dua dalam keadaan kritikal. 'Ramai penumpang berjalan kaki keluar dari serpihan, tetapi yang lain terperangkap,' katanya. Pengendali lapangan terbang menuding cuaca buruk sebagai punca utama, manakala seorang penumpang lain mencadangkan pesawat mungkin terkena arus udara kuat sejurus selepas lepas landas. Aeromexico mengekspresi pengesalan yang mendalam, menyatakan, 'Keluarga semua yang terjejas berada dalam doa dan hati kami.' Siasatan terhadap nahas ini sedang berlangsung, dengan anggaran pegawai mungkin mengambil bulan untuk menentukan punca sebenar. Presiden Mexico Enrique Pena Nieto telah menggerakkan sumber kerajaan untuk membantu, walaupun sesetengah pihak telah mengkritik tindak balas sebagai perlahan. Nahas ini telah membangkitkan persoalan tentang keselamatan penerbangan dan transparensi. Embraer 190, model yang biasanya boleh dipercayai dengan satu nahas maut sebelumnya, dipajak oleh Aeromexico pada tahun 2014. Syarikat telah berjanji untuk bekerja rapat dengan siasatan yang sedang berlangsung. Kecemasan tentang transparensi timbul apabila Aeromexico enggan mengeluarkan senarai penumpang, dan Kedutaan Amerika Syarikat tidak pasti tentang kemungkinan korban rakyat Amerika. Ini telah menimbulkan kebimbangan di kalangan mereka yang menantikan berita tentang sanak saudara.

article_content: French driver Luc Alphand has won the 14th stage of the Dakar Rally, with Stephane Peterhansel maintaining his overall lead as the rally winds through the Egyptian desert's husky terrain. Alphand, a 37-year-old former World Cup skier, navigated his BMW X5 through a grueling 316-kilometer stage in four hours, 2:20 minutes, marking BMW's first stage win this year. Jean-Pierre Fontenay, driving for Mitsubishi, secured second place, two minutes behind Alphand, while South Africa's Giniel De Villiers claimed third. In the motorcycle category, Richard Sainct, aboard his KTM, secured the stage win with a time of three hours, fourteen minutes. Cyril Despres followed in second, three minutes back, and Marc Coma in third. Sainct maintains his overall lead, now ten minutes ahead of Despres, with Italy's Fabrizio Meoni trailing by forty-two minutes. The rally continues Friday with a demanding 477-kilometer stage from Luxor to Abu Rish, Egypt. The 8,500-kilometer event concludes on Monday in Sharm el Sheikh, promising a thrilling finale.
